text: Election of the Vice Chair of the Audit Committee under Municipal Code Chapter 27, Council Procedures, Appendix A-2, for a term of office starting February 16, 2021 and ending November 14, 2022.
The Audit Committee: 1. Elected Councillor John Filion as Vice Chair of the Audit Committee for a term of office starting February 16, 2021 and ending November 14, 2022.
